diagnostics.message: COMMENT ON TABLE public.thing: the value of @name has no closing parenthesis, so it is not read; close it
COMMENT ON FUNCTION app.hidden_set(): the routine is not exposed, so dpg-snapshot reads no annotations on it, so @x.go.name is ignored; remove the annotation tokens from the comment
COMMENT ON INDEX app.items_id_key: dpg-snapshot reads no annotations on indexes, so @bound is ignored; remove the annotation tokens from the comment
COMMENT ON TYPE app.span: dpg-snapshot reads no annotations on range types, so @x.y is ignored; remove the annotation tokens from the comment
COMMENT ON POLICY texts_pub ON app.texts: dpg-snapshot reads no annotations on policies, so @bound is ignored; remove the annotation tokens from the comment
COMMENT ON TRIGGER texts_t ON app.texts: dpg-snapshot reads no annotations on triggers, so @x is ignored; remove the annotation tokens from the comment
